scope: Only selected literal DAR transfer and DECIR speech readings, as reviewed; English templates are elliptical where Spanish leaves arguments unexpressed. All source grammar, case/number, reflexivity and contextual guards in independent reviews apply.
normalization: A malformed form_of target literally containing dar/decir combined with PRON can be normalized only when the same source gloss explicitly agrees with the lemma and identical clitic text. No suffix parsing.
